explanation: Interleave searches from both candidate nodes toward the middle. Once one reaches it, search downward from the middle for the other candidate, comparing actual node references.
timeComplexity: O(h) for the ancestor/descendant test; wrapper node lookup can visit O(n)
spaceComplexity: O(1) for the test, plus wrapper lookup recursion
